import requests

response = requests.request(
    "POST",
    "https://api.test/pets",
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer [redacted]"},
    data="{\"name\":\"it's \\\"Rex\\\"\",\"n\":\"line\nbreak\",\"u\":\"é\"}".encode("utf-8"),
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
